listing.name: Resident Evil Code: Veronica X (PS2) (RECVX Enhanced Port)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Different from mere underlying decomp; 32-bit executable/library requirements and optional server should be explicit. Limits: Prerelease0.6.8 native enhanced implementation;32-bit libraries and optional co-op server remain distinct. Upstream platforms: Windows x86/32-bit executable and Linux i686 package, glibc2.34+. Optional co-op server is a separate artifact. Original data: Own NTSC-U SLUS-20184 ISO; native code based on AshfordFamily/recvx-decomp with hardware interfaces emulated. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
